meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将个人微信接入你的应用,扫码即可收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想给项目加上个人微信消息收发能力。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your app to personal WeChat via official API for messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app that needs personal WeChat messaging.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会多出个人微信渠道:手机扫码登录后,把收到的微信对话接到 Claude 上,它就能在微信里回复消息。无需配置 API 密钥,也不需要公网回调地址。
howto.when: 当你提出要把微信个人号接入 NanoClaw、要求添加微信渠道,或想让 Claude 能收到并回复微信消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接入 NanoClaw
say.note: 技能会复制微信连接代码并注册该渠道。

say.text: 我想通过微信和你聊天,配置一下
say.note: 需要你用手机扫码并批准授权。

say.text: 添加微信渠道,扫码登录我的账号
say.note: 扫码后,渠道会以你的微信号连接。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains a personal WeChat channel. You log in by scanning a QR code with your phone; once incoming WeChat conversations are wired to Claude, it can reply inside WeChat. No API keys or public webhook URLs are needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect a personal WeChat account to NanoClaw, add a WeChat channel, or let Claude send/receive WeChat messages.

say_en.text: Connect my personal WeChat to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: The skill copies the WeChat adapter and registers the channel.

say_en.text: I want to chat with you via WeChat — set it up.
say_en.note: You'll scan a QR code on your phone and approve the login.

say_en.text: Add the WeChat channel and scan to log into my account.
say_en.note: After scanning, it connects as your WeChat account.
